title: Time is Off
text: Time is Off. I've had it for almost a year (purchased it January 23, 2013), but by that summer, I noticed that it was 3 minutes ahead of time.  Recently, it's 5 minutes ahead.  Thanks to fellow Amazon reviewer and commentator, Edward Scott, I learned that the clock has a chip that sets the time, but I've found that this unit is incapable of being accurate. Mr. Scott also informed me that I can reset the time myself by using the manual buttons.  Unfortunately, that's not easy to do with my arthritic hands.  One good thing about this inaccurate timepiece: the display and bright red LEDs are very nice.
